stdout:
usage: nacre-brain-maintain curate [-h] (--page WIKI_PATH | --area NAME | --world NAME | --all)
                                   [--stale-only] [--max-pages N] [--dry-run]
                                   [--model MODEL] [--report PATH]

Rewrite wiki "Current facts" with claude -p (no tools, fixed prompt) from
bounded evidence; validate links, dates and secrets, write each page with
compare-and-swap and commit it with its context packs, one commit per page.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --page WIKI_PATH   one wiki page (wiki/x.md)
  --area NAME        the pages of an area
  --world NAME       the pages of a world
  --all              every wiki page
  --stale-only       only pages with evidence newer than their curation
  --max-pages N      at most N pages (default 10)
  --dry-run          call the model and write proposals to a report only
  --model MODEL      Claude model (default sonnet)
  --report PATH      write a Markdown report outside the vault
